The '''Krayiss Two system''', also known as the '''Krayiss system''', was a star system in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] and contained the planet [[Krayiss II]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Krayiss Two system was first mentioned in ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' and later mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. Although the system was placed within grid square R-4 by a map of [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] in ''The Essential Atlas'', the book's Appendix section listed it as being located in square R-5,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> which was repeated in the 2015 update to [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book.<ref name="EAOC" /> This article assumes the visual map placement is erroneous and that R-5 is the correct square.
